title: NP Circuits with Polynomial Size
statement: Every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ has a family of fan-in-two Boolean circuits with polynomially bounded size and polynomially many witness input bits, such that an input belongs to the language exactly when some assignment to its witness bits makes the corresponding circuit output true.
